failures.invariant: soft: debug.log notice from plugin code, no functional break
failures.triage_note: Two Free application widgets declare a bare cap slug as their ability. AbstractWidget::user_can_render() passes it to wp_is_ability_granted(), whose polyfill calls wp_get_ability('wcb_view_applications'); WP 6.9 has no ability by that name (registered one is 'wcb/view-applications'), so core logs _doing_it_wrong, then the polyfill falls back to current_user_can() and the widgets still render. Present since the widget registry landed (473c9f8, 1.1.0), not introduced by the SDK-guard commits. Previous 1.8.0 walks did not catch it because WP_DEBUG was actually off on this site (wp-config had WP_DEBUG false; debug.log never existed).
failures.expected: Opening a wcb_application edit screen in wp-admin writes nothing to debug.log (runbook D.ability-slug-format: ZERO wp_get_ability / wp_is_ability_granted notices).
failures.actual: Each load of wp-admin/post.php?post=<application>&action=edit as admin writes 2x 'PHP Notice: Function WP_Abilities_Registry::get_registered was called incorrectly. Ability "wcb_view_applications" not found' (reproduced twice: 10:45:05Z and 10:47:41Z).
failures.repro: WP_DEBUG + WP_DEBUG_LOG on, Free+Pro 1.8.0 active, WP 6.9+. As admin open wp-admin/post.php?post=<any wcb_application id>&action=edit. debug.log gains two 'Ability "wcb_view_applications" not found' notices, one per widget (application/status-changer, application/quick-actions).
